verdict.rationale: MailerSend documents registrable webhooks for real-time event notifications, with explicit retry behavior: exponential backoff for about 3 days on non-2xx or unreachable endpoints, plus a test request to verify the URL. The evidence does not name the delivered, bounced, or complained event types as webhook triggers; bounce tracking appears only as analytics data. missing for 10: documented webhook event types for delivered/bounced/complained, payload/signature documentation, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a platform engineer, I can receive webhooks for delivered, bounced, and complained events with documented retry behavior, so my app reacts to email outcomes in real time

citations.quote: Webhooks allow you to subscribe to real-time notifications about various events that occur in MailerSend.
If your endpoint is unreachable or returns a non-2xx response, MailerSend automatically retries with exponential backoff for up to about 3 days.
When creating or updating a webhook, MailerSend will send a test request to the provided URL to verify that it is reachable.
